name: web
comment:overrides: jose is pinned to v5 because jwks-rsa@4.x (via firebase-admin) declares jose ^6 but loads it with CommonJS `require('jose')` — and jose 6 is ESM-only. Locally Next bundles it so the mismatch never surfaces; on Vercel firebase-admin is auto-externalised, real Node require() runs, and EVERY api route 500s with ERR_REQUIRE_ESM. jose 5 ships a `require` condition, and the four APIs jwks-rsa uses (decodeJwt, decodeProtectedHeader, importJWK, exportSPKI) all exist in v5. jose has no other dependent. Remove once jwks-rsa loads jose via dynamic import().
